gregtech.jei.assembly_boiler: Top-down layers, bottom to top. C faces the top edge. Orange: heat base. Blue: water in. Green: steam out. Gray: keep empty.
gregtech.jei.assembly_drill: Top-center controller outputs upwards. Bedrock or bedrock ore beneath drill heads. Orange ports accept RU; titanium walls accept lubricant. Each cycle: 32768 RU + 100 mB.
gregtech.jei.assembly_dynamo: Solid 3×3×4: 17 dense walls, 18 copper coils; RU at main front, EU at rear centre.
gregtech.jei.assembly_exchanger: Main in bottom-center of 3x3 dense tungsten layer. Upper layer: center wall and eight heat transmitters. Fuel enters bottom layer; cooled fluid exits the main. Heat emits upwards at eight outlets.
gregtech.jei.assembly_fusion: 19 x 19 x 5. Core: 3 versatile, 12 logic, 12 control processors in any order. LU: middle ring except four outer cardinal EU outlets. Items/fluids: upper/lower ring. Identical continuous reactions keep startup charge.
gregtech.jei.assembly_gas_turbine: Solid 3x3x4 of 35 walls. Front layer accepts gas fuel; bottom layer drains exhaust. Rotation exits behind the rear center. Keep every exhaust tank drained. Sneak-empty-hand toggles stop.
gregtech.jei.assembly_implosion: 25 dense tungstensteel walls in a hollow 3x3x3. Controller centered on the bottom front. Keep the center air cell empty. Walls accept item I/O. Explosives and a selector circuit determine the output; no electrical input is needed.
gregtech.jei.assembly_large_machine: Controller at front-bottom center. Build the displayed layers facing north. Orange: energy; blue: input; green: output; gray: item/fluid I/O. Hover cells for their roles.
gregtech.jei.assembly_legacy: This shows the current port structure. Processing, materials and interactions are not yet fully equivalent to GT6.
gregtech.jei.assembly_lightning: Alternate tungsten and niobium-titanium coil layers. Extend the center pillar upwards to meet the height/sky requirement. Controller outputs 32768 EU packets downwards.
gregtech.jei.assembly_matter: 5 x 5 x 6: 97 dense lead walls, 26 osmium coils and one empty center. Top: 16 vents, central versatile processor, 4 control + 4 conversion processors in any order. QU input and item/fluid IO through walls/coils; auto output below controller.
gregtech.jei.assembly_steam_turbine: Solid 3×3×4: steam at front, distilled water below, RU at rear centre.
gregtech.jei.assembly_tank: Top-down layers, bottom to top. C faces the top edge. All walls allow fluid I/O. Keep the light cells empty. Controller also fits the top or bottom face center.
